title: Covered Toilet Paper Holder With Glass Shelf Wall Mount Solid Brass | Fire Engine Red | Waverly Place Collection | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade your bathroom with a covered toilet paper holder that adds a convenient glass shelf while keeping the roll protected in Fire Engine Red, which makes a fearless design statement, transforming functional bathroom hardware into a vibrant focal point. A bold choice for those who embrace color and personality in their space.

  • Fire Engine Red transforms this essential into a conversation piece
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Solid brass construction: Built for enduring strength
  • Wall mount: Space-saving installation with concealed screws for a clean look
  • Coordinated style: Part of the Waverly Place collection for matching bath accessories
